Hi Pree. I haven't saved the draft yet. The address is fine, since Tobias is internal (trendle@pemberline.com). The problem is the content: a per-seat rate counts as a finance figure. Those can go to the account owner, Anselm or June without sign-off, and Tobias is none of the three, so sending it to him needs Anselm's or June's approval. That applies even though you own the account and it's only a draft.

I've messaged June asking her to approve it. Once she does, I'll save the draft in your mailbox for you to send: to Tobias, subject "Tansley 2027 rate", with the $1,313 per seat proposed 2027 rate for the planning sheet. If you'd rather ask Anselm, or June gets back to you directly, just tell me.
